title: EVA-03 events in the ledger and the recovery join test
goal: The runner's EVA-03 events are appended to the NERV ledger, and gate test 6 (recovery join) passes before execution is enabled
acceptance: eva03.started/completed/failed/timed_out/cancelled are ledger events on the job's sortie, never erased; uncertain outcomes say so and claim no rollback
Recovery join: a crash or disconnect mid-job keeps the durable receipt and the uncertain lock, blocks a duplicate replay, and reconciles cleanly on restart (decisions/eva-runner.md, test 6)
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Join tests across runner, ledger and worker protocol; npm test
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 when split from F-049-T05 (owner decision): the runner reports events only through a callback today and has no receipt or lock. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-19: PR #553, CI run 44551320850 passed every job on attempt 3 (attempts 1 and 2: GitHub had no macOS runner, nothing ran); actual about 5 h with two review rounds and the Windows fix (stated).

prs.note: receipts and recovery join; CI green
